title: Policy Brief: Addressing the Invisible Care Economy
author: Cornelia Team
excerpt: Our latest data-driven brief quantifies the unpaid labor market and provides a framework for integrating care-work recognition into national GDP calculations, a move supported by major economic activists.
content:
Care work, predominantly performed by women, is systematically undervalued.

Economic models must account for unpaid domestic and care labor.

Policy interventions can recognize and redistribute care responsibilities equitably.
